reply.text:
Being the smaller one in the group is really common at twelve. Kids grow on very different schedules, and it says nothing about how strong you can get later.

Building a program for someone your age is one to talk through with a parent and your doctor first, so I won't set one up for you here. What helps most right now is playing a lot of sports and games, eating regular meals, and getting plenty of sleep. Learning good movement with bodyweight stuff like push-ups, squats and climbing is a great base, ideally with a coach, teacher or parent who can watch your form.

Once you've talked it over with a parent and your doctor, I'm glad to help with the training side.
